command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; PRE=$(state); echo pre_call_state=$PRE; test "$PRE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-pipe-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-pipe-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; echo '=== pipe abort offcall ==='; ABORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe pipe-abort-offcall 16000"); printf '%s
' "$ABORT"; printf '%s
' "$ABORT" | grep -q 'audio_mode=0'; printf '%s
' "$ABORT" | grep -q 'terminated_after_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$ABORT" | grep -q 'aborted_after_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$ABORT" | grep -q 'writer_rejected_after_abort=true'; test "$(state)" = "0"; echo '=== pipe start rejected offcall ==='; START=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe pipe-start-offcall 16000"); printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'audio_mode=0'; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'offcall_start_rejected=true'; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'terminated_after_start_failure=true'; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'writer_rejected_after_start_failure=true'; POST=$(state); echo post_call_state=$POST; test "$POST" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-pipe-install.log; echo phase2_pipe_offcall_device_ok=true
